entities.summary: Laura Farnsworth Dogu is an American diplomat serving as the U.S. Chargé d'Affaires to Venezuela. She previously served as the United States Ambassador to Honduras in the Biden and second Trump administrations as well as the United States Ambassador to Nicaragua in the Obama and first Trump administrations.
